name: plates-2022
notes: For data taken on the MCP plates fitted in 2022 (between 2022-08-22 and 2022-11-03; HeLab dates the swap 2022-11-03 for now), until the 2025 swap. For now it holds matlab-2019's constants, so its hits are matlab-2019's, written under its own file names; it changes only when these plates are calibrated. A plot's settings suggest it for a folder dated while its plates were in, but never pick it for you. Not calibrated yet: a run with MCP pulses in November 2022 measured time sums of 3367 bins on X and 3294 on Y on these plates, which it doesn't use yet.
